tickets.title: Prepare updated funds-flow schedule for Buttonwood sale
tickets.text: Prepare an updated funds-flow schedule for Julian Maplesprocket's Buttonwood Balloon Components sale to Copper Firefly Systems, separating gross consideration (~$20.6M), $2.2M escrow holdback, $1.5M preferred-equity rollover, tax reserves, and transaction fees to reconcile the ~$16.9M expected closing cash.
tickets.evidence: An updated funds-flow schedule is needed to separate gross consideration, holdbacks, rollover equity, tax reserves, and transaction fees by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Obtain final capitalization table and equity records
tickets.text: Obtain the final capitalization table, option-cancellation records, and manager equity acknowledgments for Julian Maplesprocket's Buttonwood Balloon Components transaction folder to confirm his 78% sale proceeds and retained obligations before the 2025-02-28 closing target.
tickets.evidence: those equity ledger and option-cancellation records are needed by 2025-01-06

tickets.title: Prepare CPA sale-tax projection package
tickets.text: Prepare the CPA sale-tax projection package for Julian Maplesprocket's Buttonwood Balloon Components sale, covering federal, Oregon, basis, installment-payment assumptions, escrow taxation, and shareholder note treatment with Alma Dewspindle at Silver Marmot Tax Partners.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the CPA sale-tax projection package by 2025-01-07.

tickets.title: Model shareholder note payoff treatment separately

tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to model the shareholder note payoff treatment by 2025-01-08.

tickets.text: Verify incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions with Teacup Comet Bank for Julian Maplesprocket's expected Buttonwood Balloon Components sale proceeds, given the prior manual-review incident on a large inbound wire.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to verify incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions by 2025-01-02.

tickets.title: Obtain final consulting agreement economics
tickets.text: Obtain final consulting agreement economics for Julian Maplesprocket's post-closing role with Copper Firefly Systems, covering compensation, expense reimbursement, termination, and noncompete interaction terms that affect his post-sale income forecast.

tickets.title: Prepare post-sale investment policy statement
tickets.text: Prepare the post-sale investment policy for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket reflecting staged deployment, cash comfort (18 months of household expenses), tax exposure, and fossil-fuel screening preferences after the Buttonwood Balloon Components sale converts much of Julian's net worth to liquid assets.

tickets.text: Prepare renovation and mortgage reserve modeling for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket covering the $900K-$1.2M Portland renovation, the $820K Portland mortgage (3.1% fixed, 2049 maturity), $310K lake-cabin mortgage, and desired liquidity floor before committing sale cash to property spending.

tickets.text: Review the insurance transition for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket after the Buttonwood Balloon Components sale, covering Julian's $3M and Priya's $2M Pocket Lantern Risk Partners term life policies, Julian's $9,000/month disability policy, the $5M umbrella, and the company-owned key-person policy on Julian.

tickets.text: Complete an estate liquidity and fiduciary review for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket addressing fiduciary roles (Priya as primary, Oren Maplesprocket as successor), trust funding assumptions, privacy, and whether the 2016 estate plan still matches their current family circumstances after the Buttonwood Balloon Components sale.

tickets.text: Prepare a charitable funding structure comparison for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket covering their usual $75,000 annual giving level, possible appreciated securities (including ~$410,000 of low-basis Marzipan Meadow Automation shares), and potential business-sale liquidity for a donor-advised fund or similar vehicle.
